title: Energy-matched country panel
about: One row per country and year, 1965–2024, for the 42 economies in the study. Fossil CO₂ by source is paired with fuel consumption for the same country-year. Countries are kept when all core variables (five CO₂ sources, coal, oil and gas consumption, population) are present in at least 40 of the 55 years 1970–2024. Aggregates (regions, income groups) were removed by keeping only entities with a country ISO code.

title: Emission-factor audit
about: Each valid implied emission factor, 1970–2024, compared with the IPCC 2006 default range (95% interval bounds of Vol. 2, Ch. 1, Table 1.4, converted from kg CO₂/TJ by × 3.6 × 10⁻⁶). Coal: coking coal lower bound to lignite upper bound; oil: ethane lower to residual fuel oil upper; gas: natural gas lower to upper. Basis of Fig. 3 and Section 2.3 of the manuscript.

cols.description: Implied emission factor (as in ef_coal, ef_oil and ef_gas of the panel file)

Upper bound of the IPCC 2006 range for the fuel. A value above it means more CO₂ is reported than the reported fuel could release

title: COMB-P extrapolation by country and source
about: COMB-P: main method of the paper: equal-weight combination of the damped trend and XGBoost, with the post-forecast stoichiometric correction. Origin 2024, horizons 1–6 years. Intervals are calibrated on the same model's test-period forecasts (origins 2008–2019) for the same source and horizon.
